jobs.title: Director, Sales Operations
jobs.description:
GumGum is The Mindset Company™ transforming advertising. We’re an advertising technology company delivering results by matching brands with people in the right mindset in the moments that matter. Our platform is powered by the Mindset Graph™, our AI-driven data engine that processes billions of real-time contextual, creative, environmental, and historical signals to match every ad with the most receptive audience. The result is advertising that drives meaningful outcomes for advertisers and publishers, and is more relevant for consumers.

We were founded in 2008 and are headquartered in Santa Monica, California, operating in over 19 markets across North America, Europe, Japan, and Australia.

Our principles guide our work every day and are as follows:

- Customer-Obsessed: We’re focused on advertising solutions that solve needs and drive success for clients and partners.

- Make it Happen: We have a bias for action and take ownership to deliver results.

- Always Innovate: We push boundaries with creativity and technology.

- Foster Belonging: We ensure colleagues feel included, supported, and empowered to thrive.

To be a part of The Mindset Company™ transforming advertising, please visit www.gumgum.com/careers .

Overview

The Director, Sales Operations at GumGum is a hands-on individual contributor role sitting between strategy and execution, responsible for managing the systems, data, and processes that drive revenue growth across global regions (NA, EMEA, JAPAC), products, and customer segments. Reporting to the VP of Sales Strategy and Operations, this role serves as the functional source of truth—partnering closely with regional sales leadership, Finance, Legal, and Product Marketing to convert complex planning rules and sales motions into seamless Salesforce configurations, trusted dashboards, and actionable seller workflows. Success requires deep technical CRM expertise, strong commercial judgment, and the ability to turn operational ambiguity into structured, reliable forecasting and scalable go-to-market execution, with potential to lead a small team as the function matures.

What You’ll Acheive

- Partner with the Salesforce owner to manage CRM configuration, data models, and workflows to align with GTM rules.

- Own the revenue reporting suite (pipeline, bookings, forecasts) and lead forecasting cadences with Sales leadership and Finance.

- Execute annual and quarterly sales planning, including territory design, account assignment, coverage models, and quota deployment.

- Deliver executive-ready performance analysis, regional business reviews, and account-level intelligence to sales leadership.

- Provide operational inputs for incentive compensation plan designs, quota models, and payout administration.

- Define and maintain sales processes, stage definitions, pricing approvals, and rules of engagement across global regions.

- Lead onboarding, tool training, and change management for reps to drive effective adoption of CRM workflows and sales motions.

Skills You’ll Bring

- 8+ years of experience in sales operations, revenue operations, sales strategy, management consulting, or sales effectiveness.

- Deep, hands-on experience owning a Salesforce environment in a complex B2B sales organization (Salesforce Admin certification preferred).

- Proven track record of executing forecasting and sales planning cycles (territory, coverage, quota deployment).

- Advanced analytical and modeling skills in Excel or Google Sheets, with working knowledge of BI tools like Tableau, Looker, or Power BI.

- Strong understanding of sales compensation mechanics, quota setting, and pipeline management.

- Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to turn complex data into actionable recommendations for executives.

- Preferred background in ad tech, digital media, or SaaS across direct/agency sales motions and global regions.

What We Offer

At GumGum, competitive base pay is a part of a total rewards package which also includes benefits, an emphasis on recognition, development, and wellness. The reasonable estimated base pay range for this role is from   $174,000 - $210,500  annually.   The actual amount may be higher or lower. Individual compensation will vary based on factors including, but not limited to, relevant qualifications, work location, and labor market conditions.

The total rewards package offered also includes an employer-matched 401(k) retirement plan, and depending on the role, participation in a bonus, commission, or stock incentive program. Your recruiter can share more specifics during the hiring process. Learn more about our U.S. benefits & perks package at gumgum.com/benefits .

Note: GumGum fosters a flexible work environment, offering GumGummers the ability to work either in-office or remotely/from home. However, for occasional in-person collaboration, we kindly ask that this position be located within a 'commutable' distance to our office.
Awards

- 2025 & 2026 Digiday Media Awards Europe Best Contextual Targeting Offering

- 2025 AdExchanger Awards AI Innovators, Technology & Service Provider, Finalist

- 2025 MARKETECH APAC Marketing Technology Awards Silver Winner for Best Contextual Advertising Tech Platform

We're always learning and evolving as a company, and we continue to take thoughtful steps to support our people and strengthen our culture.

Follow Us on Social

- Instagram: @gumgum

- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/gumgum/

- YouTube: @GumGumInc

- TikTok: @itsgumgum

Beware of recruitment scams. GumGum recruits only for active roles on our careers page, accepts applications through Greenhouse, and communicates only via LinkedIn or @gumgum.com / @ic.gumgum.com email addresses. We never use chat apps, ask you to register on other recruiting sites, or request financial information, payments or purchases. Verify suspicious outreach before sharing personal information.

GumGum is looking for a Vice President of Sales who will be instrumental in spearheading GumGum's market-leading contextual advertising platform across Central territories (Chicago, Detroit, and Ohio). Reporting directly to the SVP of Sales, this pivotal executive role requires a proven leader in the online media landscape capable of driving substantial revenue growth, cultivating high-performing teams, and building deep relationships across the advertising community. The ideal candidate brings deep ad-tech ecosystem expertise, strong coaching skills, and the strategic foresight to expand client investments across our media solutions.

Note: This position offers the opportunity for remote work or 'work from home' as there isn't a nearby office. However, GumGum is excited to only consider applicants residing in the local area listed in the job description for business needs including some or all of the following: client interaction, team interaction, timezone, etc.

What You'll Achieve

- Own revenue for GumGum's Central region — Chicago, Detroit, and Ohio — and consistently exceed target with year-over-year growth.

- Lead and grow a team of 4–8 sellers, building an inclusive, results-oriented culture where people do their best work.

- Recruit, onboard, and develop top sales talent, coaching each seller toward stronger individual and team performance.

- Translate regional strategy into ambitious, actionable goals, then coach your team on the account-based plays that hit them.

- Build deep relationships with senior brand and agency decision-makers, becoming a trusted advisor on their business.

- Expand existing client investment by upselling GumGum's In-image, In-video, and broader media solutions.

- Drive new business through proactive prospecting and qualification across the region's highest-value verticals.

- Partner with the North American Leadership Team on strategic growth initiatives, and carry client insight back to Product.

Skills You'll Bring

- A bachelor's degree in media, marketing, or advertising.

- 10+ years selling digital advertising, with a documented track record of hitting or exceeding sales targets.

- Experience leading a team against a large book of business ($15M+), with proven results coaching sellers to improve.

- An established, active network of brand and agency contacts across the Chicago, Detroit, and Ohio markets.

- Deep ad-tech ecosystem fluency and the agility to adapt as the media landscape shifts.

- Strong command of Salesforce, PowerPoint, Excel, and Word; you use Seller Crowd and follow the trades for account news.

- Superb written and verbal communication, with the executive presence to build strategic client relationships.

- Sharp analytical judgment — you read the data, understand business drivers (P&L, COGS, revenue), and solve problems fast.

What We Offer

At GumGum, competitive base pay is a part of a total rewards package which also includes benefits, an emphasis on recognition, development, and wellness. The reasonable estimated  OTE pay range (base + commission)  for this role is from $456,000 - $521,000 . The actual amount may be higher or lower. Individual compensation will vary based on factors including, but not limited to, relevant qualifications, work location, and labor market conditions.

The total rewards package offered also includes an employer-matched 401(k) retirement plan, and depending on the role, participation in a bonus, commission, or stock incentive program. Your recruiter can share more specifics during the hiring process. Learn more about our U.S. benefits & perks package at gumgum.com/benefits .
